pages.title: Back into a Book
pages.text: Extract the first real enchantment from an item at a Grindstone and receive its Enchanted Book.

pages.title: Back into a Book
pages.text: Move earned enchantments to another item; books and lapis support your next deliberate enchantment choice.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sneak-right-click a Grindstone with the enchanted item in your main hand. The current handler removes the first displayed enchantment and produces its book; cost history refunds 70% of actually paid XP once. No selection menu is promised.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Sneak-use on a Grindstone extracts the first displayed enchantment into a book.70% paid-XP refund is receipt-protected; legacy items have a separate one-shot path, not an infinite income loop.
